chunks: Ahmad narrated from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When the month of Ramadan is safe (complete/perfect), the year is safe (complete/perfect)." And he said, "The head of the year is the month of Ramadan."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ramadan in relation to the Islamic year according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the concept of 'salama' (safety/completeness) is applied metaphorically to indicate that Ramadan serves as the spiritual cornerstone for the entire year. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that the quality of one's worship in the 'chief of months' determines the spiritual trajectory and divine acceptance for the remaining eleven months.
